what: Human baselines for blind-spot: timed attempts by people with a digital-design background, on the SAME tasks the Inspect variants serve (task_id = seed-index, the verifiers taskset at seed 2027), graded by the SAME scorer (blind_spot.adapters_v0._decide: a KILL is simulated on the netlist, EQUIVALENT is checked against the SAT proof). Without this file's attempts there is no time horizon; with them, deliverable 2 of notes/metr-plan-2026-09-21.md can be fit.
status: NO DATA. The operator recruits (the request is drafted in outreach/blind-spot-baselines-request-2026-09-21.md and is a SEND); nothing in `attempts` is a measurement until a row is there. The ledger (certs/blind-spot-inspect-ledger.json) pins this file by sha256 and the battery refuses if it moves without the ledger being re-run — `python3 environments/blind_spot/inspect/ledger.py` after every edit.

protocol.who: 5-10 people per rung with digital-design background (RTL, verification, or formal); a baseliner may attempt more than one rung, never the same task twice.
protocol.what_they_see: The task prompt, verbatim (Sample.input: the design in words, the rung's information, the answer format). The netlist listing corpus/blindspot/mut/core_euclid_strict.v is available on request. NO simulator, NO SAT solver, no model: pen, paper, a calculator, and a plain-text editor for the answer.
protocol.time: Wall clock from the moment the prompt is shown to the moment the answer file is saved; the baseliner reports it; the recruiter records it. A baseliner may stop with UNDECIDED at any moment and that is a valid, scored outcome (reward 0).
protocol.answer: The JSON object the prompt asks for, saved to a file named <task_id>.json. It is graded afterwards by `python3 environments/blind_spot/inspect/ledger.py --grade-baselines`, which runs the exact verifier and refuses the file if a stored outcome disagrees with the scorer.
protocol.solved: reward +1 from the scorer: a submitted pair flips a pin in simulation, or EQUIVALENT on a mutant the miter proved equivalent. Nothing else counts, including a correct diagnosis with no killing pair.
protocol.tasks_per_rung: the first six sample ids of each Inspect variant at seed 2027 (num_tasks=6, start=0), listed under `tasks`; a baseliner draws tasks in the order listed and attempts as many as their time allows.
protocol.consent: Each attempt row carries `consent`: the baseliner's pseudonym, the date, and the line they agreed to (`consent_line`). Names are never stored; the pseudonym is chosen by the baseliner.

consent_line: I agree that my timed attempt (the time I took, my answer and its scored outcome) is recorded under a pseudonym I chose and may be published as part of a human-baseline table for the blind-spot task; no name, e-mail or employer is recorded.

attempt_schema.background: one line: e.g. 'RTL design, 6 years' — free text, no employer
attempt_schema.outcome: filled by ledger.py --grade-baselines: SOLVED | MISSED | WRONG | UNDECIDED | REFUSED_PARSE
